items.html: And indeed, what is lacking here from Ima of Beriah is her Ohr Makif, for she has no Makif at all. And ZA of Beriah is certainly a complete Partzuf, but what is added to him is that he has one Makif, for everything that is smaller than its fellow can be revealed more than its fellow. Therefore the Partzufim of Beriah go from degree to degree.
